The epitope of 8B6 Fab on the Na-dependent serotonin transporter (SERT) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The Na-dependent serotonin transporter construct ts3 contained three thermostabilizing mutations (I292A, T439S, Y110A) and mutation of surface-exposed cysteines C554A, C580A and C622A. The antidepressant (s)-citalopram was bound to SERT by soaking into the crystal. The 8B6 Fab was used as an aid in crystallization.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.24 angstroms

The epitope of 8B6 Fab on the Na-dependent serotonin transporter (SERT) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The Na-dependent serotonin transporter construct ts3 contained three thermostabilizing mutations (I292A, T439S, Y110A) and mutation of surface-exposed cysteines C554A, C580A and C622A. SERT was crystallized with a bromine derivative of the antidepressant citalopram, (R/S)-1-[3-(dimethylamino)propyl]-1-(4-bromophenyl)-1,3-dihydroisobenzofuran-5-carbonitrile, in which the 4-fluoro group is replaced with a bromine atom (Br-citalopram). The 8B6 Fab was used as an aid in crystallization.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.39 angstroms

The epitope of 8B6 Fab on the Na-dependent serotonin transporter (SERT) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The Na-dependent serotonin transporter construct ts3 contained three thermostabilizing mutations (I292A, T439S, Y110A) and mutation of surface-exposed cysteines C554A, C580A and C622A. A bromine derivative of the antidepressant citalopram, (R/S)-1-[3-(dimethylamino)propyl]-1-(4-bromophenyl)-1,3-dihydroisobenzofuran-5-carbonitrile, in which the 4-fluoro group is replaced with a bromine atom (Br-citalopram), was soaked into the SERT-Fab crystal. The 8B6 Fab was used as an aid in crystallization.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.49 angstroms

The epitope of 8B6 Fab on the Na-dependent serotonin transporter (SERT) was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction at 4.1 Å resolution of the wild-type human serotonin transporter complexed with Br-paroxetine and 8B6 Fab. The 8B6 Fab was used as an aid in crystallization.

The epitope of 8B6 Fab on the Na-dependent serotonin transporter (SERT) was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction at 3.3 Å resolution of the wild-type human serotonin transporter complexed with paroxetine and 8B6 Fab. The 8B6 Fab was used as an aid in crystallization.

The epitope of 8B6 scFv on the Na-dependent serotonin transporter (SERT) was determined from the single particle cryo-EM reconstruction at a resolution of 4.3 Å of the complex of SERT bound by 8B6 scFv and 15B8 Fab. The ts2-inactive, outward-open human serotonin transporter contained thermostabilizing mutations and was bound to the antidepressant paroxetine. The antibody fragments were used to  provide mass and molecular features to facilitate cryo-EM reconstruction.

The ts2-active, outward-open human serotonin transporter contained thermostabilizing mutations and was bound to the non-competitive inhibitor ibogaine. The antibody fragments were used to  provide mass and molecular features to facilitate cryo-EM reconstruction.

The epitope of 15B8 Fab on the Na-dependent serotonin transporter (SERT) was determined from the single particle cryo-EM reconstruction at a resolution of 4.2 Å of the complex of SERT bound by 15B8 Fab. The human serotonin transporter construct ΔN72/C13 was an N- and C-terminally truncated SERT construct, and was bound to the non-competitive inhibitor ibogaine in NaCl. The complex was in an occluded conformation. The antibody fragments were used to provide mass and molecular features to facilitate cryo-EM reconstruction.

The human serotonin transporter construct ΔN72/C13 was an N- and C-terminally truncated SERT construct, and was bound to the non-competitive inhibitor ibogaine in KCl. The complex is in the inward-open conformation. The antibody fragments were used to provide mass and molecular features to facilitate cryo-EM reconstruction.
